title: RC, RL and RLC circuits (0D)
description: Step responses of RC, RL and series RLC circuits integrated numerically (Kirchhoff's laws as ODEs, scipy solve_ivp). The time constants, the damped frequency and the decay rate are measured from the waveforms (fits and zero crossings) and compared with the closed forms; in the free RLC decay the energy dissipated in R equals the energy first stored in C.

metrics.name: rel_error[0D: RC time constant (fit of ln(1 - V/V0))]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (closed_form: tau = R C (Nilsson & Riedel sec. 7.2))

metrics.name: rel_error[0D: RL time constant]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (closed_form: tau = L / R (Nilsson & Riedel sec. 7.1))

metrics.name: rel_error[0D: RL final current]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (closed_form: I(inf) = V0 / R; the value at 6 tau divided by (1 - e^-6))

metrics.name: rel_error[0D: RLC damped angular frequency (zero crossings)]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (closed_form: omega_d = sqrt(1/(L C) - (R/2L)^2) (Nilsson & Riedel sec. 8.3))

metrics.name: rel_error[0D: RLC decay rate (log decrement of extrema)]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (closed_form: alpha = R / (2 L) (Nilsson & Riedel sec. 8.3))

metrics.name: rel_error[0D: energy dissipated in R (free decay)]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (conservation: energy conservation: 1/2 C V0^2 stored at t = 0)

metrics.name: 0D: quality_factor
metrics.how: Q = omega0 / (2 alpha) from the circuit values
